text:
alex: heads-up — us-west2-b GPU pool (a100-80GB) is showing mass OOMs and kube is starting node drains. 12/20 nodes in that pool marked NotReady. P95 inference latency +30% on hosted. initiating zonal evacuation?

marta: understoood — what's the scope? all models or specific runtime?

alex: looks like driver/kernel OOMs tied to recent gpu-image rollout. both tensor-rt and cuda libs show crashes. affects both rtx and a100 shapes but mostly a100-80GB nodes. pods being evicted, a few failing to re-schedule.

infra-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: GPU node eviction rate (us-west2-b) > 10/min. Auto-escalation enabled.

jp: can we cordon the affected nodes and shift traffic to us-west2-a/c? avoid full region failover, prefer zonal shifting. also trigger autoscaler to provision elsewhere.

sofia: agree w/ jp. prefer gradual shift to reduce errors. use canary draining (2 nodes at a time). set routing policy fallback to other zones for low-latency routes only.

marta: commands to run — cordon + drain snippet:
```
# cordon
kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-usw2-b -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl cordon
# drain (ignore daemonsets, force evict)
kubectl drain <node-name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```
run one at a time, wait for pods to land.

alex: starting canary: draining node gpu-usw2b-07 and gpu-usw2b-09 now. oncall, please watch cold-start / timeout errors for routed requests.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0318-uw2b — Pager escalation sent to oncall rotation. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0318-uw2b

jp: provisioning request: spin up 8 A100s in us-west2-a via provisioning API. Note: spot preemption risk. if Dedicated capacity available in us-west2-a, promote to dedicated pools to avoid churn.

sofia: cost check — routing ~20% traffic to Dedicated for 24h estimated +$3k/day. Approve?

marta: :thumbsup: approved for 24h emergency. track burn in the console and flag if > $5k.

alex: manual LB weight change (canary):
```
curl -XPOST "https://controlplane.local/api/route/update" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","weights":{"us-west2-a":0.6,"us-west2-c":0.4}}'
```
pushed to staging, will rollout to prod in 30s window if metrics stable.

infra-bot: Autoscaler event: us-west2-a scaling 10 -> 18 nodes (ETA 5m). Provisioning request submitted.

jp: warmup plan: run light generate workload for common prompts to pre-populate KV cache on new nodes. I'll kick off warmup job with batch size 4 for 10 minutes.

marta: monitoring — after canary drain, token/s dropped 12% but 99th latency returned to baseline for canary traffic. continuing drains in 2-node batches.

alex: root cause preliminary: kernel driver regression introduced in gpu-image v2026.03.15. Filed CR: CR-2201 to revert image from rotation and block new rollouts.

sofia: rollout plan: revert image in us-west2-b, bake a patched image, canary to us-west2-c then backfill drained nodes. update runbook to include image rollback steps.

alex: noted. will update incident doc and move remaining nodes to drained state after warm caches are present in replacement zones. thanks all.

marta: quick checklist saved to incident doc: cordon->drain (2x), update LB weights, provision capacity, warm caches, revert image, validate metrics, reintroduce nodes.

alex: closing here — will post final status when us-west2-b is back to normal. keep alerts open.
